name: scapewatch-mobile
description: Mobile presentation and Android packaging for Scapewatch

scripts.test:gestures: npm run build && playwright test --project gestures
scripts.test:renderer: npm run build && playwright test --project renderer
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build:release && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
